notes: Fresh-state Stern MPU-200 solenoid test. Four Self Test presses reach the solenoid test, which pulses one driver at a time and shows its driver-position (SDU Q) number on the player displays, so each printed solenoid number pairs with the public address that fires. Presses are held 600 ms. Run on the galaxyb seven-digit conversion clone to compare its solenoid order with the production ROM.
